enchantment.minecraft.aqua_affinity.desc: Removes the underwater mining speed penalty.
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: Deals extra damage to arthropods (spiders, silverfish, bees, etc.) and slows them.
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc: Prevents removing worn equipment until death or breakage.
enchantment.minecraft.breach.desc: Makes the target's armor less effective against mace hits.
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: Calls lightning when a thrown trident hits under open sky during a thunderstorm.
enchantment.minecraft.density.desc: Adds mace smash damage for each block fallen.
enchantment.minecraft.efficiency.desc: Speeds up mining with a suitable tool.
enchantment.minecraft.feather_falling.de: Reduces damage from falling and ender pearl teleportation.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_aspect.desc: Sets targets on fire with melee attacks.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Reduces fire and lava damage and shortens burning.
enchantment.minecraft.flame.desc: Makes arrows fired from a bow set targets on fire.
enchantment.minecraft.fortune.desc: Increases drops from certain blocks, including many ores.
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc: Freezes water beneath your feet and prevents magma block damage.
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc: Increases trident damage against aquatic mobs, excluding drowned.
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc: Fires normal arrows without consuming them; requires one in your inventory.
enchantment.minecraft.knockback.desc: Pushes targets farther away with melee attacks.
enchantment.minecraft.looting.desc: Increases mob drops and the chance of rare drops.
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc: Returns a thrown trident to its owner.
enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.de: Improves fishing loot: more treasure and less junk.
enchantment.minecraft.lunge.desc: Propels you forward when jabbing with a spear, consuming hunger and durability.
enchantment.minecraft.lure.desc: Shortens the wait for a bite while fishing.
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc: Uses collected experience to repair held or worn equipment.
enchantment.minecraft.multishot.desc: Fires three crossbow projectiles while consuming one.
enchantment.minecraft.piercing.desc: Lets crossbow arrows pass through multiple targets and shields.
enchantment.minecraft.power.desc: Increases damage dealt by arrows fired from a bow.
enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect: Reduces damage from arrows and other projectiles.
enchantment.minecraft.protection.desc: Reduces most types of incoming damage.
enchantment.minecraft.punch.desc: Increases knockback from arrows fired from a bow.
enchantment.minecraft.respiration.desc: Lets you stay underwater longer before drowning.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc: Launches you with your trident while in water or rain.
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc: Harvests supported blocks themselves instead of their usual drops.
enchantment.minecraft.smite.desc: Deals extra damage to undead mobs (zombies, skeletons, the Wither, etc.).
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc: Increases movement speed on soul sand and soul soil.
enchantment.minecraft.sweeping_edge.desc: Increases sword sweep damage to nearby targets.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc: Can damage attackers when you are hit; wears out armor faster.
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc: Gives the item a chance to avoid durability loss.
enchantment.minecraft.vanishing_curse.de: Makes the item disappear on death instead of dropping.
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc: Launches you upward after a successful mace smash attack.
